text:
alex: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — observed regional LB retry spike during cert rollover window, looks like a slow propagation of the new certs + routing splay.
maria: thanks. can we capture owners & short timelines here? need to feed to the oncall runbook.
sre_tiffany: I can own the immediate follow-ups: make cert rollout atomic across regions and add a TTL/monitoring guard. timeline: 2 weeks for rollout changes, 3 days for monitoring alerts.
jon: +1. i'll take the routing-side mitigation: add a temporary route preference patch to avoid regional fanout during rollover. PR target: EOD Thursday. JIRA: NET-1587.
julia: i'll own the post-deploy validation checks (synthetic probes + header checks). will add probes for cert age + sni match. ETA: next Tues.
ops_mark: noted. can we also get a short-term mitigation that reduces user-facing retries? i saw spike in 5xxs during the window.
alex: short-term: enable conservative retry backoff in the LB for 6 hours around expected rollouts, and set a feature flag so marketing can opt out for critical tenants. who wants flag ownership?
maria: i'll take the feature flag + docs for SRE playbook. will create a small runbook entry.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolling update scheduled: cert-rollover-service v1.3.4 -> v1.3.5 at 2024-11-06T03:00Z (dry-run will happen first).
sre_tiffany: for recurrence detection — i've started a PromQL alert to detect regional retry rate > baseline by 3x for 10m. Query:
```
sum by(region)(rate(lb_retry_total[10m])) / sum by(region)(rate(lb_request_total[10m])) > 0.03
```
alerts -> #incidents and paging for sev2.
jon: nice. also ran a quick grep on ingress logs, saw correlated BGP withdrawal messages ~10s before the retry surge. adding networking ticket NET-1590 to track BGP flaps and retention window.
julia: adding validation job: runs post-rollout: curl -I https://<regional-lb>/health -H "Host: app.example.com" --resolve entry for each region, check SNI cert subject. I'll add it to CI so rollout fails fast.
ops_mark: action items summary pls (owner, jira, ETA) — let's keep it tight and use this thread as the tracker.
alex: summary below:
- owner:sre_tiffany, task: make cert rollout atomic + monitoring guard, jira: NET-1588, eta: 2w
- owner:jon, task: routing preference patch, jira: NET-1587, eta: Thu EOD
- owner:julia, task: post-deploy validation probes + CI check, jira: NET-1589, eta: Tue next week
- owner:maria, task: feature flag + runbook, jira: OPS-742, eta: 3d
- owner:ops_mark, task: coordinate tenant opt-out and comms, jira: OPS-743, eta: 1d
please add or correct.
maria: added runbook draft and comms note, link: https://confluence.redwood/example/net-retry-rollout (internal). :thumbsup:
sre_tiffany: scheduling a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to review NET tickets and acceptance criteria. invite sent.
alex: thanks all — we'll mark this thread as the canonical action tracker. ping here when PRs are ready or if timelines slip. :white_check_mark:
